# Extension tags

<!-- Generated by python3 tools/ci/surface_extension_tags.py; do not edit. -->

Packages may add to exactly these tags in the reserved `sunrise` namespace.
Normal tag merging applies, including `replace: true`. Other reserved files remain refused.
Generated `sunrise:class/*` tags cannot be written; attach a part with `block_part_tag` instead.
